ADVERTISING OPTIONS

Eight ways to reach them

Every package is scoped to your goals and budget. There is no rate card here by design - let's talk about the right mix

01
LinkedIn Carousel
A co-branded PDF of up to 15 slides, made by our team, published in the feed, with a lifetime spot in the AI Library
Ideal for education-led demand and building credibility
02
LinkedIn Main Ad
Top placement in the LinkedIn newsletter, sent as email and posted to the feed. One partner per issue
Ideal for desktop-first offers: demos, extensions, announcements
03
Email Primary Ad
Top placement in the email newsletter, with full look-through analytics for retargeting. One partner per issue
Ideal for mobile offers: downloads, webinars
04
Email Secondary Ad
Mid-issue placement, between editorial blocks. Max two per issue
Ideal for always-on awareness at a lower entry point
05
Tools Ad
Your logo in our curated Favourite Tools section, next to tools readers already trust. Max four per issue
Ideal for self-serve signups and free trials
06
Dedicated Issue
100% share of voice. The whole send is yours, written in the AI Central voice readers trust
Ideal for major launches and high-ticket offers
07
Welcome Sequence
A dedicated email inside our welcome sequence, delivered to every new subscriber for 3 months
Ideal for predictable, compounding lead flow
08
Website Banner
Always-on banner on thecentral.ai, 20,000 visitors a month, every page
Ideal for continuous visibility between campaigns

HOW IT WORKS

Six steps, and a guarantee

1
Brief
We agree the goal, the content angle, the target reader, and the date
2
Create
Our team writes and designs the placement. You approve it before it goes out
3
Publish
We publish across the agreed channels: email, LinkedIn newsletter, feed, website
4
Check in
A mid-campaign call to review performance so far and adjust if needed
5
Report
You get a performance report: impressions, clicks, downloads, signups
6
Plan the next one
We bring follow-up campaign ideas based on what worked
Guaranteed results policy
Every engagement has agreed targets for impressions, clicks or downloads. If the first run does not reach them, we keep publishing supporting placements at no extra cost until it does
Custom bundles combine carousels, main ads, dedicated issues and interviews, scoped to your goals and quoted as one engagement

Alex Fiore
Founder and Chief Editor, AI Central Media
Alex leads the editorial team. He is a founding member of the San Francisco AI Collective, and part of the Data and AI Group at Global Tech Advocates in London. He teaches AI and monetization at Cozora Academy, writes for several industry magazines, and holds an MSc in quantitative finance. Before AI Central, he was on the founding team of a UK AI fintech, where he built the go-to-market strategy and led the platform launch, taking the company from $0 to $16M ARR
